user.title: Start WattWatch
user.description: Submit to start. WattWatch discovers power sensors and learns for at least 7 days. No device selection or helpers are required. Alerts appear in Home Assistant. Open the WattWatch device page for the automatic overview. Exceptions can be changed later in Configure.

init.title: Optional settings
init.description: No changes are required. Exclusions override inclusions. Only W, kW and mW sensors are monitored. Negative readings are not sampled.
